panels.title: Target Status
panels.description: Counts of selected targets by scrape/readiness status. Down means failed scrape; Not ready means storage startup/runtime health is not ready; Ready is not serving authority or FULL population readiness; Unknown means readiness telemetry is missing. No targets is not a healthy state: check the LavikNoTargets alert.

Prometheus alert counts at the selected range end, filtered by Lavik instance. Critical/Warning count firing rule instances, including inhibited or silenced notifications; Pending is not yet firing. The Canvas title bar uses right-anchored field values so the summary stays beside Alerts. A missing field/query failure displays ? rather than a healthy zero.

panels.title: Current Alerts
panels.description: Pending and firing Prometheus alerts at the selected range end. Active for starts when the condition first became active, including pending and keep_firing_for. Each rule/instance/scope remains separate; notification inhibition and silences do not remove rows. No data means no active samples, not proof of service health. Built-in alert names map to runbook sections and stable metric panel IDs; custom names fall back to policy and Target Status.

panels.description: P99.9 and P99.99 are estimates interpolated from Prometheus histogram buckets. Lavik exports dense boundaries around the 3 ms SLO and progressively wider buckets at higher latency; use longer windows for low-volume traffic.
panels.title: Command Latency Percentiles

panels.description: Completed storage reads, writes, and fdatasync barriers per second. Each series is aggregated across workers for the selected instance.
panels.title: Storage IOPS

panels.description: Completed storage read/write bytes per second. fdatasync is the logical write volume newly covered by successful durability barriers, not a device-reported physical transfer count.
panels.title: Storage Throughput
Command Executions and Errors
panels.description: Redis commandstats rates. Completed calls include failed calls; rejections happen before execution and include MOVED/ASK. EXEC and script children count under their command names. Queue replies do not count.

panels.title: Errors by Prefix
panels.description: Global Redis errorstats by RESP prefix, including caught script errors. Forwarding the same script error does not count twice. Custom prefixes share OTHER. The command filter does not apply.

targets.expr: (sum by (instance, command) (rate(lavik_command_failed_calls_total{job="lavik",instance=~"$instance",command=~"${command:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance, command) (rate(lavik_command_executions_total{job="lavik",instance=~"$instance",command=~"${command:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)) and on (instance) (up{job="lavik",instance=~"$instance"} == 1)

panels.title: Execution Failure Ratio
panels.description: Failed calls / completed executions. Includes client and server errors. Rejections and queued commands are outside the denominator. Observed idle commands show zero; missing telemetry shows No Data.

targets.expr: (sum by (instance, command) (rate(lavik_command_rejected_calls_total{job="lavik",instance=~"$instance",command=~"${command:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min((sum by (instance, command) (rate(lavik_command_executions_total{job="lavik",instance=~"$instance",command=~"${command:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (instance, command) (rate(lavik_command_rejected_calls_total{job="lavik",instance=~"$instance",command=~"${command:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))), 1e-9)) and on (instance) (up{job="lavik",instance=~"$instance"} == 1)

panels.title: Admission Rejection Ratio
panels.description: Rejected calls / (completed calls + rejected calls), including MOVED/ASK. Queued commands are excluded. Observed idle commands show zero; missing telemetry shows No Data.

targets.expr: (sum by (instance, command) (rate(lavik_command_execution_seconds_total{job="lavik",instance=~"$instance",command=~"${command:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance, command) (rate(lavik_command_executions_total{job="lavik",instance=~"$instance",command=~"${command:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)) and on (instance) (up{job="lavik",instance=~"$instance"} == 1)

panels.title: Mean Command Execution Time
panels.description: Execution seconds / completed calls. Excludes admission, dormant blocking waits and socket writes. Includes storage and cross-worker waits; parent times include their children. This is elapsed execution time, not CPU time or end-to-end latency.

panels.title: Request Input Errors
panels.description: Malformed protocol, query-buffer limit and client-memory admission failures have no valid command identity. The command filter does not apply.

Sealed, unreclaimed Tx record bytes: sum and largest worker. Excludes active blocks and extents; not block count, metadata heap or an admission threshold. P99 measures command execution, excluding socket response writes.
panels.title: Tx Backlog and Command P99

panels.description: Rounds are attempts, not successful reclamation. Running is a boolean. Zero cooldown disables online cleaning.
panels.title: Tx Cleaner Activity

panels.description: Counts advance when batches are dequeued for processing, before durability succeeds. Fence series show input and merged work, not completed durable commits.
panels.title: Commit Batches and Fences

panels.description: Depth is global queued receipts, excluding dequeued in-flight batches. Peak is the historical global maximum. Backpressure counts enqueues encountering a per-worker watermark, not wait duration. Do not divide global depth by the per-worker watermark.
panels.title: Commit Queue and Backpressure

panels.description: Dirty bytes include queued and in-flight flushes. Completed write/fdatasync calls are a process-wide progress proxy; unrelated writes can mask a stalled transaction.
panels.title: Dirty Staging and I/O Progress

panels.description: Flushes count active worker flush runners, not blocks or I/Os. Commit chains include dequeued in-flight work. Pending is a conservatively sampled boolean, not an atomic durability barrier during writes.
panels.title: Pending Durability Work

panels.description: Queue watermark applies independently to each worker. Pause count is current nesting depth, not accumulated events. Cooldown zero disables online cleaning; default backlog alerts are suppressed above 300 seconds.
panels.title: Storage Diagnostic Settings and Pauses

panels.description: Estimated from Prometheus histogram buckets. Lavik exports SLO-focused boundaries at 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4, 5, 6, and 8 ms.
panels.title: Command P99.9 Latency

panels.description: Estimated from Prometheus histogram buckets; precision is limited by bucket width and sample volume.
panels.title: Command P99.99 Latency

panels.description: Correlates per-instance command P99.9 latency with running, queued, paused, and configured defrag work.
panels.title: Defrag Impact on P99.9 Latency

panels.description: Worker-local retained bytes plus pending allocation and full-sync reservations as a percentage of that worker's fixed retained-memory share.
panels.title: Worker Retained Admission Utilization
Memory Admission Rejections
panels.description: Actual rejected growth, including low-traffic incidents. This is not a command error ratio.

panels.title: Meta Data Observation Time
panels.description: Time spent collecting data state before sending a heartbeat, including cross-shard waits. Completed steps only; histogram quantiles are estimates. This is not the heartbeat interval or scheduler jitter, and has no automatic 1 ms warning threshold.

panels.title: Meta Lease Installation Time
panels.description: Time spent installing authority after receiving a lease, including cross-shard waits. Completed steps only; histogram quantiles are estimates. This is not the heartbeat interval or scheduler jitter, and has no automatic 1 ms warning threshold.

panels.title: Meta Connection State
panels.description: 1 means the control session is connected; 0 means disconnected. Missing data indicates unavailable scraping and must not be interpreted as zero.

panels.title: Meta Lease Decision Rate
panels.description: Lease grants and denials received by each Data node, separated by decision.

panels.title: Meta Exceptions (5 min)
panels.description: Local lease expirations, reconnect attempts, and protocol errors over the last 5 minutes. Prometheus increase may return fractional values due to extrapolation.

panels.title: Meta State and Directive Results (5 min)
panels.description: Complete desired-state applications and Data-side directive outcomes by node over the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Backlog and Publisher Pressure
panels.description: Publisher queue occupancy; compare backlog backpressure and retained replica claims.

panels.title: FULL Publication Queue Pressure
panels.description: Queued plus admitted bytes divided by aggregate active-session capacity. May exceed one for oversized commands; does not prove stalled progress.

panels.title: Received and Applied Events
panels.description: Process counters survive reconnects and reset on restart. Only complete ONLINE events count; no rate is taken from raw LSN.

panels.title: Native Replication Without Progress
panels.description: A step ages only while it has known pending work. Idle is zero; unavailable or non-applicable online cursors are omitted. Default warnings at 300s and critical at 480s require a connected flow.

panels.title: Native Pending Events
panels.description: Source: maximum Published-to-observed-ACK distance among comparable downstream sessions. Target: Received-to-Applied. Event positions, never bytes; no cross-node subtraction. FULL with no online cursor is absent.

panels.title: Native FULL Phases
panels.description: Locally observed phases only. Snapshot and concurrent incremental transfer share one transfer phase. Source cannot report target internal promotion. Gaps mean no sampled active phase; check observation availability and readiness.

panels.title: Native FULL Results and Retries (15 min)
panels.description: Failures exclude normal cancellation; FULL busy and authority waits are retries. Counters are process-local. Use INFO and correlated session/history logs for individual outcomes.

panels.title: Native Population and Readiness
panels.description: These facts are independent: catalog completion, population readiness, online connection and dataset readability never replace each other. Readability does not grant Meta serving authority. Missing samples are unavailable.

panels.title: Native FULL Duration
panels.description: Current attempt and phase durations, plus historical terminal-attempt p95 including all results. A large FULL is not stalled merely because its total duration is long.

panels.title: Native FULL Work
panels.description: Actual data-frame bytes include framing and ONLINE transfer. FULL items are snapshot record payloads (including fragments) and complete incremental commands. Completed partition handoffs are counted across attempts. No estimated percentage.

targets.expr: label_replace(((lavik_replication_native_following{job="lavik",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on(instance) (lavik_replication_native_connected{job="lavik",instance=~"$instance"} == 0) and on(instance) (lavik_replication_waiting{job="lavik",instance=~"$instance"} == 0) unless on(instance) (sum by(instance)(lavik_replication_fullsync_phase{job="lavik",instance=~"$instance"}) > 0)) * 0 + 1, "state", "disconnected", "instance", ".*")

panels.title: Native Replication States
panels.description: States describe current known work. Disconnected and admission/authority waiting are separate from confirmed stalls. FULL progresses through locally visible phases. An empty panel is unknown or no native relationship; inspect observation availability.

title: Lavik Overview
